description: Probes the default gateway and configured TCP targets for reachability and latency, and files target-down and latency-spike signals.
name: latency_post

signals.description: A probed gateway or configured target stopped answering TCP probes (not already reported down).
signals.name: target_down

signals.description: A target's probe latency rose above both spike_ms and spike_factor times its recent median latency.
signals.name: latency_spike
